what: Hand-drawn illustrations and note cards flip between just two poses, +4° and −4°, once per second with no in-between values, like paper-puppet stop-motion. With look: hover they wobble ±1° every .6 seconds only while hovered (hand-drawn button). With look: nudge they do not tilt and instead jump between three positions per second (0 → −1,−1 → +1,−1px) with step-end, so the red handwritten memo jitters. With look: lift they stand straight and scale 1.3× while hovered (titan-art sticker, where only the sign of its own tilt flips every 1.5 seconds: --fx-dur 3s).

options.--fx-angle: Shake angle (via style), default 4deg — 1deg for buttons
options.--fx-dur: Length of one round trip (via style), default 1s · hover type is .6s
options.--fx-delay: Start delay (via style), default 0s — stagger from neighbors with .5s
options.look: hover: Shakes only while hovered (keyboard focus too)
options.look: nudge: Instead of tilt, a jitter (step-end) hopping 1px between three positions — --fx-nudge sets the width, --fx-delay .2s · .4s · .6s staggers it
options.--fx-nudge: Travel range of the nudge type (via style), default 1px
options.look: lift: Sways, then while hovered (keyboard focus too) stops, stands upright and scales by --fx-lift (default 1.3) — snaps with no in-between values (titan-art sticker)
options.--fx-lift: Growing scale for the lift type (via style), default 1.3
options.--fx-angle-b: Second pose angle (via style), default is the opposite of --fx-angle — at 0deg it alternates between tilted and upright

use: Button
note: Because the whole transform is used, any tilt or position transform on the attached element disappears while it shakes (the original does the same). To shake while tilted, tilt the outer box and attach to the inner one

from.where: index.html hand-drawn illustrations · PICK UP card (.illust ±4° 1s, .illust2 delayed .5s) · logo hover (±4° 1s) · button hover (.btn:hover ±1° .6s)
index.html red handwritten note .animation-wave (1s step-end infinite, translate −1,−1 → 1,−1, delays .2 · .4 · .6s, off at 767px and below)
